
`r ct` {data-navmenu="Splicing by contrast"}
=====================================

```{r}
d      <- ds[[ct]]
ct_row <- contrasts[contrasts$contrast == ct, ]
n_hi   <- if (nrow(d)) sum(d$direction == "Higher inclusion") else 0
n_lo   <- if (nrow(d)) sum(d$direction == "Lower inclusion") else 0
```

```{r}
ps <- list(df = NULL, note = "")
if (nrow(d)) {
    pd <- d |> filter(!is.na(FDR)) |>
        # rMATS cannot resolve FDR below ~1e-15 and reports those events as 0; draw them at 1e-16
        mutate(neglog10 = round(-log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-16)), 3), dPSI = round(dPSI, 3),
               group = ifelse(direction == "NS", "NS", event_type),
               group = factor(group, levels = c("NS", event_types)))
    ps <- sample_points(pd, pd$direction != "NS")
}
```

### ΔPSI volcano (`r ds_rule``r ps$note`)

```{r}
if (!nrow(d)) {
    message_box("rMATS reported no events for this contrast.")
} else {
    pd <- ps$df
    plot_ly(pd, x = ~dPSI, y = ~neglog10, color = ~group, colors = c(NS = col_ns, event_cols),
            text = ~paste0(gene_name, " (", event_type, ")"), customdata = ~location,
            type = "scattergl", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 5, opacity = 0.7),
            hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>%{customdata}<br>ΔPSI %{x:.3f}<br>-log10 FDR %{y:.1f}<extra></extra>") |>
        layout(xaxis = list(title = "ΔPSI (treatment − control)", range = c(-1, 1)),
               yaxis = list(title = "-log10 FDR (FDR reported as 0 drawn at 16)"),
               legend = list(orientation = "h", y = 1.08)) |>
        compact_plotly()
}
```

### ΔPSI of significant events by type

```{r}
sig <- if (nrow(d)) d |> filter(direction != "NS") else d
if (!nrow(sig)) {
    message_box(paste0("No events pass ", ds_rule, " for this contrast."))
} else {
    sig_t <- sig |> mutate(event_type = factor(event_type, levels = event_types))
    if (nrow(sig) <= 3000) {
        # few events: draw every point
        plot_ly(sig_t, x = ~event_type, y = ~dPSI, color = ~event_type, colors = event_cols, type = "box",
                boxpoints = "all", jitter = 0.4, pointpos = 0, marker = list(size = 3, opacity = 0.5),
                text = ~gene_name, hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>ΔPSI %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>") |>
            layout(showlegend = FALSE, xaxis = list(title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "ΔPSI (treatment − control)", range = c(-1, 1)))
    } else {
        # many events: embed only the box statistics (Tukey whiskers), not every value
        st <- sig_t |> group_by(event_type) |>
            summarise(q1 = quantile(dPSI, 0.25), med = median(dPSI), q3 = quantile(dPSI, 0.75),
                      lo = min(dPSI[dPSI >= q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1)]), hi = max(dPSI[dPSI <= q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1)]),
                      n = n(), .groups = "drop")
        # five values per type (whisker ends, quartiles, median) redraw the same box with the
        # "inclusive" quartile method
        bx <- st |> mutate(x = paste0(event_type, " (n = ", format(n, big.mark = ","), ")")) |>
            rowwise() |> reframe(event_type, x, y = c(lo, q1, med, q3, hi))
        p <- plot_ly(bx, x = ~x, y = ~y, color = ~event_type, colors = event_cols, type = "box",
                     quartilemethod = "inclusive", boxpoints = FALSE, hoverinfo = "y")
        p |> layout(showlegend = FALSE, xaxis = list(title = "", type = "category"),
                    yaxis = list(title = "ΔPSI (treatment − control)", range = c(-1, 1)))
    }
}
```

### Significant events by type and direction (`r ds_rule`)

```{r}
if (!nrow(sig)) {
    message_box(paste0("No events pass ", ds_rule, " for this contrast."))
} else {
    cnt <- sig |> mutate(event_type = factor(event_type, levels = event_types)) |>
        group_by(event_type, .drop = FALSE) |>
        summarise(hi = sum(direction == "Higher inclusion"), lo = sum(direction == "Lower inclusion"),
                  .groups = "drop")
    updown_barplot(paste0(cnt$event_type, " (", event_labels[as.character(cnt$event_type)], ")"),
                   cnt$hi, cnt$lo, up_name = "Higher inclusion", down_name = "Lower inclusion",
                   ylab = "Number of DS events", legend_title = "Inclusion in treatment", noun = "events")
}
```

```{r}
# Top significant events of each type (lowest FDR, then largest |ΔPSI|), PSI per sample
n_per_type <- as.integer(params$event_heatmap_per_type)
hm_psi     <- identical(params$event_heatmap_scale, "psi")   # raw PSI (0-1) instead of row z-scores
hm_ev <- if (nrow(sig) && n_per_type > 0) {
    sig |> mutate(event_type = factor(event_type, levels = event_types)) |>
        arrange(event_type, FDR, desc(abs(dPSI))) |>
        group_by(event_type) |> slice_head(n = n_per_type) |> ungroup()
} else sig[0, ]
hm_height <- max(300, 18 * nrow(hm_ev) + 30 * length(unique(hm_ev$event_type)) + 280)
```

Row {data-height=`r hm_height`}
-------------------------------------

### Top `r n_per_type` significant events per type: PSI per sample (`r if (hm_psi) "PSI" else "row z-scores of PSI; hover for PSI"`)

```{r}
if (nrow(hm_ev) < 2) {
    message_box("A heatmap needs at least two significant events.")
} else {
    psi <- event_psi(hm_ev, ct)
    x_lab <- paste0(colnames(psi), " (", sample_cond[colnames(psi)], ")")
    types <- intersect(event_types, as.character(hm_ev$event_type))
    # One panel per event type; within each, rows are clustered by Euclidean distance of their
    # PSI z-score profiles (complete linkage), with the dendrogram on the left
    panels <- lapply(seq_along(types), function(i) {
        ty  <- types[i]
        idx <- which(hm_ev$event_type == ty)
        m   <- psi[idx, , drop = FALSE]
        z   <- row_z(m)
        e   <- hm_ev[idx, ]
        txt <- matrix(paste0("<b>", e$gene_name, "</b> (", ty, ")<br>", e$location,
                             "<br>ΔPSI ", sprintf("%.3f", e$dPSI), ", FDR ", fmt_p(e$FDR)),
                      nrow(e), ncol(m))
        txt <- matrix(paste0(txt, "<br>", rep(x_lab, each = nrow(e)), "<br>PSI ",
                             ifelse(is.na(m), "NA", sprintf("%.3f", m)), ", z = ", sprintf("%.2f", z)), nrow(e))
        cluster_heatmap(z, x_lab, event_label(e), txt, zs = if (hm_psi) m else z,
                        colors = if (hm_psi) grDevices::hcl.colors(101, "YlGnBu", rev = TRUE) else div_cols,
                        zmin = if (hm_psi) 0 else -2.5, zmax = if (hm_psi) 1 else 2.5, showscale = i == 1,
                        colorbar = list(title = list(text = if (hm_psi) "PSI" else "z", side = "top"),
                                        orientation = "h", x = 0.75, xanchor = "center", y = 1,
                                        yanchor = "bottom", len = 0.35, thickness = 12),
                        show_x = i == length(types))$plot |>
            layout(annotations = list(list(text = paste0("<b>", ty, "</b> — ", event_labels[[ty]]),
                                           x = 0, xref = "paper", xanchor = "left", y = 1, yref = "paper",
                                           yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 12))))
    })
    heights <- unname(vapply(types, function(ty) sum(hm_ev$event_type == ty), numeric(1)))
    heights <- heights / sum(heights)
    subplot(panels, nrows = length(panels), shareX = FALSE, titleX = TRUE, titleY = FALSE,
            heights = heights, margin = c(0, 0, 0.035, 0.012)) |>
        layout(margin = list(b = 170, l = 10, r = 10, t = 50))
}
```

### Significant splicing events (`r ds_rule`)

```{r}
if (nrow(sig)) {
    tab <- sig |> arrange(FDR, desc(abs(dPSI))) |>
        transmute(event_id, event_type, gene_id, gene_name, location,
                  PSI_treatment, PSI_control, dPSI, PValue, FDR, junction_reads)
    capped_table(tab, paste0(ct, "_DS_events.tsv"),
                 numeric_cols = c("PSI_treatment", "PSI_control", "dPSI"), sci_cols = c("PValue", "FDR"))
} else {
    message_box("No significant events to list.")
}
```
